# B"H — Perutas Reputation (geelooy/api/perutas/reputation/)

Single module: `reputationService.js`. Reputation scoring within the peruta
economy — standing derived from account/transaction history (fraud signals,
ledgers, receipts). Aggregated as `reputation` in `../index.js`.
